title: A broke hungry subject takes paid work: the earn step is wired at arrival, takeable iff no threat and alive at the meal
summary: Arrival derives the action from the building (meal, shift, or end); shift_takeable = no present threat and alive at the meal; the pull escalates over the whole step; a held shift is interrupted only by a present threat; paired run on main 15/15 identical; D73-shape probe: no starvation rise, no loop, N1 0
